A hidden gem for private dining in Hà Nội
Apr 2026 • Solo
Easy to find, with a cozy and intimate atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable the moment you walk in. The food is absolutely delicious, with flavors that really linger, truly one of the best private chef experiences in Hà Nội.

I’ll definitely be returning to Diệu’s Cuisine on another occasion, and I’m genuinely excited to see what Chef Diệu creates next. 😊

Swiss Meal in West Lake Hanoi
Mar 2026 • Friends
Three Swiss friends of mine who were visiting Vietnam joined me at Dieu’s Cuisine Kollektiv for a Swiss dinner, and it turned out to be a truly comforting and memorable experience.
We enjoyed classic dishes like fondue, raclette, Zurich veal style, and chicken cordon bleu, and every dish tasted wonderfully authentic — rich, warm, and full of home-cooked flavors. My Swiss friends were especially happy to find these familiar tastes so far from home.
We also tried their special pizza, which was a pleasant surprise, and finished with dessert: a fluffy Kaiserschmarrn and their signature banana pancake — both absolutely delicious.
To complete the evening, we had a shot of sambuca, which made the dinner feel perfectly rounded.
The host was incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating such a warm and lovely atmosphere. You can truly feel the passion and care behind both the food and the hospitality.
A perfect dinner from start to finish — 10/10. I will definitely recommend it to friends and anyone looking for a cozy, home-style dining experience.

Written March 9, 2026
Feliona CH
Thank you so much for your beautiful and thoughtful words — reading this truly means a lot to me. It was such a pleasure to welcome you and your Swiss friends and to share a little taste of home here in Vietnam. Knowing that the dishes brought comfort and familiar memories, even so far away, is exactly the feeling I hope to create at Dieu’s Cuisine Kollektiv — bringing a small piece of Zurich with me to Hanoi, a place I’ve grown deeply fond of and that has become part of my journey.

I’m especially happy that you enjoyed the full experience — from the classic Swiss dishes to the desserts, and finishing the evening together with a sambuca. Moments like these are what make all the effort truly worthwhile.

Thank you again for your kindness, your support, and for recommending us. You are always warmly welcome back, and I hope our paths cross again for another cozy dinner soon. ✨

Warm regards,
Dieu

Enjoy a delicious meal above Westlake in Hanoi with Dieu's Cuisine Kollektiv!!
Nov 2025 • Family
Dieu's Cuisine Kollektiv is a unique culinary delight in a beautiful setting in Hanoi. Our friend Dieu is a talented chef and warm host. She presents a memorable, curated dinner at her latest restaurant on Westlake Hanoi in the Tay Ho District. 

Dieu's restaurant is on the 8th floor of a chic building in this upscale district. Her restaurant has a balcony overlooking Westlake where the views of the sunset and the city lights are spectacular. Her decor is comfortable and cozy. Tables are topped in cheerful red-checked tablecloths reflecting the time Dieu has spent in Switzerland and France developing her culinary skills. 

Dieu is a warm host and speaks fluent English. Her cuisine reflects Vietnamese and European influences. She has a good imported wine list and makes a delicious tiramisu for dessert. The atmosphere, food and service are excellent and it's a good value for such a beautiful spot. And be sure to have Dieu's signature cocktail with Vietnamese herbs. So delicious!!

Dieu hosted my husband and I for a lovely evening in November 2025 that was a reunion for us as well! My sister-in-law and I were in Hanoi in 2019 and chanced upon her restaurant near our hotel. We spent a wonderful evening with Dieu getting to know about her culinary journey. We have kept in touch ever since. So it was a treat and a pleasure to reconnect six years later! 

Beyond intimate dinners, Dieu also prepares feasts for groups for special occasions for work and travel groups, friends and families. 

For a beautiful spot in Hanoi in a nice, walkable neighborhood, look up Dieu's Cuisine Kollektiv and enjoy wine and fine food above the lake with a view. And please give our sincerest and warmest regards to our friend Dieu! We only wish we could visit more often!

Dieu’s has always been more than a restaurant to me. It is a place where stories meet, where memories are created, and where people come together over food, laughter, and warmth. Knowing that you felt this — that you saw and felt the love behind every detail — means more to me than I can express.
Thank you for seeing my journey, for supporting it, and for being part of it. Your kindness, your loyalty, and your friendship remind me why I chose this path and why I continue, even on the hard days.
Please give my warmest love to your husband and family. My door — and my kitchen — will always be open to you. And who knows… perhaps our next reunion will be in California, sharing another beautiful moment together, wherever life leads us next.
With all my love and gratitude,
